title: Piercing Frame Solo #119 (일반 얼굴 컷 · P200 정의형 · 일반 · 슬릭백 · 발레아쥬 · 메이크업 TurkishGlam · 금속 로즈골드·보석 오팔)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Turkish woman — warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, dark roots fading smoothly into sun-kissed lighter ends (balayage) hair styled in a sleek wet-look slicked straight back. Real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded.

Piercings: An extreme, overwhelming armour of about two hundred real rose-gold piercings with a few red-enamel beads among them covering the face, neck and shoulders: a thick rose-gold septum ring with a smaller ring above it, three rose-gold rings through each nostril and a small stud at the tip of the nose; two straight rose-gold bars across the bridge of the nose between the brows; six rose-gold pieces in a row along the outer half of each eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; three rows of five small rose-gold studs across the forehead above the brows; six small studs up each temple on the bone, well clear of the eyes; two rows of six small studs along each cheekbone; a rose-gold Medusa stud above the lips with a small stud on each side of it; a big rose-gold hoop, four smaller rings and a snake-bite ring on each side through the lower lip's edge, and six small hoops along the upper lip's edge; a rose-gold labret stud and five rings through the chin; six small studs along each jaw; a column of five small studs down each side of the neck; on each ear a full dense row of twelve oversized hoops, thick bars, stretched plugs, helix rings and studs from lobe to top, the biggest hoops hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulders; a row of six small rose-gold studs along each collarbone; and twelve fine rose-gold chains looping from the ear hoops to the nostril rings and the septum ring. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Each piece carries small opals set into the metal. All jewelry is real rose gold, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Lighting: a soft frontal beauty light on the face with a thin cool rim light along the hair, pure pitch black void background, shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
